descricao: The first area of Level 98 is a small repeating section of a straight, building-lined street with a brick road. The level loops, however the wanderer also appears to repeat with it. For example if you stood in the middle of the road and looked straight ahead, you would be able to see many copies of yourself, which move at the same time as you. Almost none of the buildings on the street can be opened, except for the buildings you enter out of, and a single diner in the middle of the section of the street.
